```{r}
identify_outliers <- function(x, multiplier=2){
  iqr <- IQR(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  #lower <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) - (multiplier * iqr)
  upper <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) + (multiplier * iqr)
  
  #outliers = x[x < lower | x > upper]
  outliers = x[x > upper]
  return(outliers)
}

plot_df = data.frame("AverageCount" = rowMeans(deseq_object$ddsnorm),
                     "PeakLength" = width(GRanges(rownames(deseq_object$ddsnorm))))

#  geom_point()

multiplier = 5
tmp = identify_outliers(plot_df$AverageCount, multiplier)
if (length(tmp) > 0){

          multiplier, length(tmp))
}

tmp = identify_outliers(plot_df$PeakLength, multiplier)
```

## Differentially Accessible Peaks {.tabset}

```{r}
clean_de_results <- function(deseq_df, peaks_annot) {
  cols_to_remove = c("seqnames", "start", "end", "width", "strand", "all_summits", "mean_summit", "summit_spread")
  
  df <- data.frame(deseq_df) %>%
      mutate(peak_coord = rownames(.)) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(as.data.frame(peaks_annot), by = "peak_coord") %>%
      dplyr::select(-all_of(cols_to_remove)) %>% 
      mutate(annotation_class = sub("\\s*\\(.*", "", annotation)) %>%
      dplyr::relocate("peak_coord") 
  
  return(df)
}

if ("res_list_annot" %ni% names(deseq_object)){
  deseq_object$res_list_annot = list()
  for (i in names(deseq_object$res_list)){
    deseq_object$res_list_annot[[i]] = clean_de_results(deseq_df = deseq_object$res_list[[i]], 
                                                   peaks_annot = consensus_peaks[["dataset_peaks_filt"]])
  }
}
```

### MA Plot
```{r}
padj_thresh  <- 0.05
lfc_thresh   <- 0
```

```{r}
internal_MA_plot <- function(plot_df, padj_thresh, lfc_thresh){
  
  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(sig = case_when(
      padj > padj_thresh | is.na(padj) ~ "NS",
      log2FoldChange >= lfc_thresh ~ "up",
      log2FoldChange <= -lfc_thresh ~ "down",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
      )) %>%
    mutate(sig = factor(sig, levels = c("down", "up", "NS")))

  lf_lim = max(abs(plot_df$log2FoldChange))
  sig_counts <- table(factor(plot_df$sig, levels=c("down","up","NS")))

  g1 <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x=log2(baseMean), y=log2FoldChange, col=sig)) + 
    geom_point() + 
    scale_color_manual(values=c("darkblue", "#A30000", "grey"), 
                       name="", drop=FALSE, 
                       lab=c(paste0("Down: ",sig_counts[["down"]]), 
                             paste0("Up: ", sig_counts[["up"]]),
                             paste0("NS: ", sig_counts[["NS"]]))) +
    ylim(c(-lf_lim, lf_lim)) +
    theme_bw() + 
    xlab("Log2 Mean Expression") + ylab("Log2 Fold Change")
  return(g1)
}

for (cond in names(deseq_object$res_list)){
  g1 <- internal_MA_plot(data.frame(deseq_object$res_list[[cond]]), 
                         padj_thresh, 
                         lfc_thresh) + 
    ggtitle(sprintf("MA plot: %s vs 0h", cond))
  print(g1)
}
```

### Peak Annotation
```{r}
internal_class_barchart <- function(input_df, padj_thresh, lfc_thresh){
  #annot_df must have "peak_coord"
  
  # df <- data.frame(input_df) %>%
  #   mutate(peak_coord = rownames(.)) %>%
  #   dplyr::left_join(annot_df, by = c("peak_coord")) %>% 
  #   tibble::column_to_rownames("peak_coord") %>%
  #   dplyr::select(-seqnames, -start, -end, -width, -strand) %>%
  #   mutate(annotation_class=sub("\\s*\\(.*", "", annotation))
  
  plot_df = data.frame(input_df) %>% 
    dplyr::filter(padj < padj_thresh & !is.na(padj), abs(log2FoldChange) >= lfc_thresh) %>% 
    pull(annotation_class) %>% 
    table() %>% 
    as.data.frame() 
  
  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
    message(sprintf("No DE peaks found at padj < %s and |LFC| >= %s", 
                    padj_thresh, lfc_thresh))
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  colnames(plot_df) <- c("annotation_class", "count")
  plot_df$prop <- plot_df$count / sum(plot_df$count)
  
  g1 <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = reorder(annotation_class, -prop), y = prop)) +
    geom_col(fill="steelblue") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
    geom_text(aes(label = count), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) + 
    labs(x = "Peak Annotation Class", 
         y = "Proportion of Total DE Peaks")
    
  return(g1)
}

for (cond in names(deseq_object$res_list_annot)){
  g1 <- internal_class_barchart(deseq_object$res_list_annot[[cond]], 
                                padj_thresh, 
                                lfc_thresh) +
    ggtitle(sprintf("DE Peak Annotations: %s vs 0h", cond))
  print(g1)
}

```


### Motif Enrichment
```{r}
output_pwms <- function(sel, outpath){
  pwms <- rowData(sel)$motif.pwm
  names <- rowData(sel)$motif.name
  motif <- rowData(sel)$motif.id
  
  for (i in seq_along(pwms)) {
    png(sprintf("%s/%s_%s.png", outpath, names[i], motif[i]), width=800, height=400)
    mat <- exp(pwms[[i]]@profileMatrix)
    mat <- sweep(mat, 2, colSums(mat), "/")
    seqLogo::seqLogo(mat)  
    dev.off()
  }
}
```

### GSEA Enrichment: GO
```{r}
plotGO <- function(plot_df, title=""){
    g1 <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = reorder(Description, NES), 
                              y = NES, size = setSize, color = p.adjust)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 40)) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "firebrick",high = "steelblue") +
    scale_size(range = c(2, 6)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)", 
         color = "Adjusted p-value", size = "Gene set size") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) 
  
  
  g2 <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = reorder(Description, NES), y = NES)) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 40)) +
    theme_bw() + 
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)" )
  
  grid.arrange(g1, g2, ncol=2, top = title)
}
```

## Cross-sample comparisons
```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
## 2 sample specific plots:

make_tmp <- function(df) {
  tmp <- as.data.frame(df[, c("log2FoldChange", "padj")])
  tmp$peak <- rownames(tmp)
  tmp$sig <- ifelse(is.na(tmp$padj) | tmp$padj > 0.05, "NS", "sig")
  return(tmp)
}

xy_FCplot <- function(plot_df){
  tbl = table(factor(plot_df$sig, levels=c("neither","both","6hr_only", "24hr_only")))
  
  g1 <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x=log2FoldChange_6hr, y=log2FoldChange_24hr, col=sig)) + 
    geom_point(size=1) + 
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("grey", "salmon", "orange", "cornflowerblue"),
      name="DE peak in:", drop=FALSE, 
      labels=c(paste0("Neither: ",tbl[["neither"]]),
               paste0("Both TPs: ",tbl[["both"]]), 
               paste0("6hr only: ",tbl[["6hr_only"]]), 
               paste0("24hr only: ",tbl[["24hr_only"]]))
      ) +
  xlab("Log2 Fold Change: 6hr vs 0hr") +
  ylab("Log2 Fold Change: 24hr vs 0hr") +
  ggtitle("Shared DE peaks between conditions") +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") + 
  theme_bw() 
  return(g1)
}

count_heatmap <- function(mymat){
  scaled_mat = t(scale(t(mymat)))
  ht <- Heatmap(scaled_mat, 
              name = "Z-score", 
              show_column_names = TRUE, 
              show_row_names = FALSE,
              cluster_columns = TRUE,
              #col = colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("darkblue", "white", "#A30000")), 
              heatmap_legend_param = list(direction="vertical", nrow=1),
              row_title = "Shared DE Peaks", row_title_rot = 90, 
              column_title = "Samples", column_title_rot = 0, 
              column_title_side = "bottom", column_names_rot = 45)
              #use_raster = TRUE)
  return(ht)
}
```

```{r}

if (all(sort(names(deseq_object$res_list)) == c("24h","6h"))) {

  tmp1 <- make_tmp(deseq_object$res_list[["6h"]])
  tmp2 <- make_tmp(deseq_object$res_list[["24h"]])
  
  plot_df <- full_join(tmp1, tmp2, by = "peak", suffix = c("_6hr","_24hr"))
  plot_df$sig <- with(plot_df, ifelse(sig_6hr=="sig" & sig_24hr=="sig","both",
                               ifelse(sig_6hr=="sig" & sig_24hr!="sig","6hr_only",
                               ifelse(sig_6hr!="sig" & sig_24hr=="sig","24hr_only","neither"))))
  plot_df$sig <- as.factor(plot_df$sig)
  plot_df$sig <- factor(plot_df$sig, levels = c("neither","both", "6hr_only", "24hr_only"))
  plot_df <- plot_df %>% arrange(sig)
  
  g1 = xy_FCplot(plot_df)
  print(g1)
  
  plot_df_shared = plot_df %>% filter(sig=="both")
  if (nrow(plot_df_shared) != 0){
    mymat <- deseq_object$ddsnorm %>% 
      data.frame() %>% 
      filter(row.names(deseq_object$ddsnorm) %in% plot_df_shared$peak)
    ht <- count_heatmap(mymat)
    draw(ht, merge_legend = TRUE)
    
  }
}
```
